objective: Raise a new Pudge Wars league entrant, derived from the repo's default Python policy (coworld/player), up the Competition division ladder by making one attributable, hosted-verified change per iteration.

league.name: Pudge Wars
league.ladder_shape: two entrants (slots 0 and 3) plus four league filler seats (1,2,4,5); Elo k=8, division score = mean round score

identity.note: Select with `coworld player use <player_id>` and verify with `tools/hosted.py whoami` before any upload or eval.

baseline.description: Repo default Python policy: coworld/player at the commit below, Dockerfile defaults PUDGE_PERSONALITY=rusher, POLICY_ARM=combined. Identical to the bundled 'Rusher' starter in the pudge-wars 0.3.21 manifest.

reference.note: Current #1 (Aaron). Named-target comparison reference and top_n member; NOT our baseline.

latest.status: v6 (v4 + long-hook pull gate: throw a >=30-tile hook only if the enemy would be at or below our HP+40 after the predicted hook damage; +pull_skip trace) uploaded 12:56Z by devin-c6eafeae, source 3830bbe, image sha256:ab76d9ba... UNTESTED: smoke and matched directional pending (see open_evals). Upload tags omitted; VERSION_LOG/ledger are the metadata of record.

candidate_directions: east-seat weakness (v4 0.550 / v5 0.368 east vs 0.75-0.80 west) - inspect east replays/hold geometry
gate long throws on target HP / opponent type (pulling a full-HP rusher in without a kill cost the v16 matchup)
close the v4-vs-v1 gate question before stacking more candidates on an un-promoted base

accepted_behaviour.note: latest behaviour the next candidate builds on: v1 + edge-band clamp (iteration 3, verdict rerun). v4 is NOT promoted over champion v1; see pending_decisions.

champion.note: v3 challenged in iteration 2 and was rejected (see ledger iteration 2 / experiments/2026-09-17-collision-threat.md); v1 remains champion. Every candidate builds on the champion's behavior, never on a rejected candidate.

eval_protocol.primary: Experience request on the league target: roster = [our policy, top_n=3], slots auto (-1); the platform seats the league fillers like the ladder does. Report clean win rate with binomial SE, split by team side (west/east) and by opponent, taint-filtered. Baseline and candidate are run on this identical protocol at equal n in the same window; the delta between them is the verdict.
eval_protocol.secondary: Pairwise experience request vs reference.ladder_anchor_ref at equal n, same window, as a named-target check.
eval_protocol.counterfactual_evals: DISABLED for this league (API 409 'counterfactual eval is disabled for this league', 2026-09-17). Re-check occasionally with `hosted.py cf create --n 3`; if enabled it becomes the primary protocol.
eval_protocol.promotion_rule: Promote over the champion only when candidate clean win rate exceeds the champion's on the same protocol/window by more than 2 pooled SE, taint rate is within background, no team-side or top-3 opponent regression beyond 1 SE, and zero tracebacks in policy logs.
eval_protocol.budget_rule: Read `tools/hosted.py budget` before launching. Do not launch if remaining_usd < 40; each 3v3 episode costs roughly the observed per-episode delta recorded in ledger hosted_compute_usd.

submission.note: League submission is irreversible and needs explicit human go-ahead each time. Set allowed=true only when the user says so, and record the quote in user_preferences.md.

cost.note: Devin bills sessions in ACUs; the per-ACU price is on the org's plan, not exposed by the API. Set usd_per_acu to fill LLM USD in LEDGER.md.

findings.note: XP request with roster [ours, top_n=3] seats 2 participants (1v1: position 0 west, 1 east) even though variant_name is 'League 3v3'. Ladder scheduler is team_pair/blocks with filler_policy, ranking elo k=8 mean. 1v1 XP results may not transfer to 3v3 ladder rounds; next run should probe a 6-slot roster (ours x3 vs top_n x3 or ours+fillers) and compare seat counts in episodes.json before trusting transfer.

Owner position must not be used to infer a flying hook's heading: the owner may Blink after the throw while the head keeps its heading (examples/pudge_wars/human_play.md). Only head displacement between ticks is trustworthy; v2 used the owner fallback in ~1% of classifications and was superseded by v3.

v3 (ignore wide/away hooks by tracked heading) rejected: matched n=40 top-3 directional 0.325±0.074 vs v1 0.425±0.078 (-0.93 pooled SE), deaths 19.70 vs 18.33/game, vs a-aron-pudge-rusher:v1 0.231 vs 0.615 (n=13). ~101 'wide' classifications/game were hooks v1 would have dodged; hook accuracy did not improve (0.178 vs 0.181). Rollback to v1; see closed_levers.md.

v1 replays (40 clean): 31% of own-bank time within 8 tiles of top/bottom edge; long hooks aimed at us there land 16.4% vs 9.6% lane / 8.9% mid; 6.9 of 16.7 landed long hooks per game are caught in the edge band. pudge-wars-rusher:v16 spends 19% there. Basis for iteration 3 (hold y clamp).

Replay lead sweep on v1 (6507 hooks, fitted radius 6.1 tiles): modeled accuracy peaks at span/12 (0.471 vs 0.363 no-lead, current span/30 = 0.410) but target dodge was generated against the real hook so this is diagnostic only; a hosted A/B is needed before touching the lead. evals/iter0-directional/lead_sweep.json.

The 03:00Z automation run (session devin-88e8709d) started iteration 3 on top of v3 while the bootstrap session was still finishing v3's directional verdict. Rule: an iteration's base_ref is STATE.champion at the time of upload; if a candidate's verdict is still open, wait for it or build on the champion. Unbuilt automation change was rebuilt here as v4 on v1.

v4 (v1 + fishing-hold y clamp [30,98]) directional n=40 top-3: 0.750+-0.068 vs v1 0.425+-0.078 matched / 0.400+-0.063 fresh n=60; deaths 18.3->10.7/game, opponent hook accuracy 0.187->0.132, own throws unchanged (383/game), own accuracy 0.181->0.147. Replay decode (bootstrap session): own edge-time share 0.314->0.023, long hooks landed on us at the edge 6.92->0.38/game. Strongest lever found so far; the remaining death budget (10.7/game) is now mid-lane exposure, not edge pinning.

blockers.resolution: 09Z run (devin-00a960a6): Docker Hub blob pull still fails (production.cloudfront.docker.com EOF). Worked around without network: auto-optimizer/tools/offline_base_image.sh (committed) copies the host pyenv CPython 3.12.13 (interpreter, stdlib, pip, OpenSSL 3.0.2 + shared libs, CA certs) into a rootfs, `docker import` it as localpy:3.12-slim and `docker tag` it python:3.12-slim so the unchanged Dockerfile builds offline (pip reaches pypi.org, which is allowlisted). v5 built and uploaded this way (VERSION_LOG v5 records the base-image deviation). The helper is committed in the branch; the blueprint should recreate it or the network policy should add production.cloudfront.docker.com so future runs use the official base.
